Specify a vector control intervention for OpenMalaria

Source: R/xml_export.R
om_vector_control.Rd

Specifies an ITN or IRS intervention for the OpenMalaria export (define_OM_vector_control, deploy_OM_vector_control, get_OM_xml, om_scenario_values) from its efficacies and decays, without a model or a duration: the export builds the intervention with the entomology of the scenario, over the right period. Efficacies and decays are as in build_intervention.

Usage

om_vector_control(
  efficacy,
  halflife_attrition = NULL,
  shape_attrition = NULL,
  decay_attrition = "weibull",
  halflife_insecticide = NULL,
  component_decay = NULL,
  insecticide_decay = TRUE,
  mode = NULL,
  name = NULL,
  fit_years = NULL
)

Arguments

efficacy

Named efficacies (Deterrency, PrePrandial, PostPrandial, KillingDuringHostSeekingAbsolute), or the output of get_ITN_params, whose efficacy, insecticide decay, model structure and name are used (unless given here).

halflife_attrition, shape_attrition, decay_attrition

Attrition decay, as in build_intervention() (halflife_attrition in days).

halflife_insecticide, component_decay, insecticide_decay

Per-component insecticide decay, as in build_intervention().

mode

"standard" or "dummy_host" (default: from the efficacies).

name

Optional name (used for the OpenMalaria ids if no other name is given).

fit_years

Window (years) over which a Weibull is fitted to each effect's decay when attrition and insecticide decay cannot be exported as a single OpenMalaria decay (default: 3 years for ITNs, 1 year for IRS, chosen by intervention_type at the export).

Value

An object of class om_vector_control.

See also

define_OM_vector_control, get_ITN_params

Examples

# Built-in parameterisation
ig2 = om_vector_control(get_ITN_params("Interceptor G2", "Kibondo",
                                       mode = "dummy_host", verbose = FALSE),
                        halflife_attrition = 2 * 365, shape_attrition = 2)
# Custom net
custom = om_vector_control(
    c(Deterrency = 0.3, KillingDuringHostSeekingAbsolute = 0.5,
      PostPrandial = 0.4),
    halflife_attrition = 2 * 365, shape_attrition = 2, name = "Custom ITN")
